name: Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd
title: Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd - 500620 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 profit on spot-heavy tanker, LPG and offshore exposure; management gives no earnings outlook, sees crude-tanker order book near 20% with supply arriving CY27-28, and is holding cash rather than buying at current yields.

triggers.label: Crude tanker orderbook ~20%
triggers.quote: The order book continues to be at around 20%.

triggers.label: Asset prices up 10-20% in quarter
triggers.quote: We are looking at about 10% to 20% increase during the quarter.

triggers.label: LPG rates near all-time highs
triggers.quote: Close to all-time highs. No, probably the all-time highs.

triggers.label: Yard slots freeing up for VLCCs
triggers.quote: It's just a movement that more of it is available for these large crude tankers.

guidance.quote: So we don't give earnings outlook.

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on rig repricing and outlook
red_flags.quote: So we will have to look for business for those rigs.

red_flags.label: Jack-up ONGC tender cancellations
red_flags.quote: in last 2 years, we have seen continuous cancellations.

evasions.quote: We're not going to forecast the Q1 numbers.
We can't comment on the first part of this question.
We can't comment on what rates we will get once she's free.
